name: Barnsley Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Mondays and Thursdays.

name: Barnsley Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Locke Park with 35 plots
months: this garden provides growing space and runs therapeutic horticulture sessions.

name: Barnsley Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Barnsley Library reducing food waste
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food. Open Monday-Saturday.
